## findings

**T0-F1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (proof assertion): the renewal fee's stated near-miss misstates the world, and the deposit it names separates no careless reading from the rule.**
- Symptom: `design_rationale` [Factor card — renewal plan fee]: "near miss: the 2026-08-14 deposit sits exactly one month back and does not count"; `evaluation_criteria[8].argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount`: "the 2026-08-14 deposit is on the boundary month and excluded".
- Root cause / evidence: the window boundary is "later than the same calendar day one month before the renewal date" = later than 2026-08-24; deposit `1816cd66…` is dated 2026-08-14, ten days before that boundary, not on it and not "exactly one month back". 
- Demonstrated consequence: every careless reading of the window gives the same tier as the rule — previous calendar month (the base `wallet_msr_dd_prev_month`): 08-14 + 08-28 = 2 deposits, 2840.00 → 25 %; last 30 days: 08-28 + 09-11 → 25 %; no window at all: 3 deposits, 4260.00 → 25 %. So the payroll-deposit ladder is applied correctly by inspection, and the renewal computation has no record whose exclusion by the rule changes any tier (the other renewal factors read single records: one membership, one vault, one card, one restriction). The asserted boundary near-miss does not exist in this world. The red light rests on the false world-assertion in the proof (Step 3: an assertion that contradicts the recomputation is red-lit under the relationship it supports); the letter of the near-miss test — a record a careless calendar-month reader counts and the rule excludes — is still met by `1816cd66…`, which is why the frozen section above passed the near-miss. Scored values (4.79, 3418.38) are unaffected; the transfer computation's near-misses (2026-09-05 funding pull, 2026-08-20 top-up and business sale, first advance) are genuine.
- Affected: `tasks/0.json` `design_rationale` (factor card) and `evaluation_criteria[8].argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount`; seed: the renewal computation's near-miss evidence. Relation to previous revisions: first round.

**T0-O1 — observation:** the persona's passive line "If the representative tells you something already due on your account is being booked before the transfer, you say that is fine" and the general authorisation "take care of anything on the Pocketwire side" name no prerequisite and fire only after the agent raises it; they do not short-circuit the tree.

**T0-O2 — observation:** the rationale labels `payroll_deposit_reduction` (count and total of the same deposit rows) and `rewards_member_reduction` (status and tier of one membership row) "multi-source"; neither spans distinct records. The task's multi-source requirement is met by `advance_repayment_reserve` and `business_shortfall_reserve`, so no consequence. The rationale also says "the 2026-08-20 sale is one month back" (it is 35 days back, outside the window; the conclusion is right).
